description.html: This glass terrarium (30x30x50 cm, 45 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

The vertical orientation (50 cm tall) makes this terrarium suitable for arboreal animals, which live in tree canopies and on trunks in the wild. You can add branches, cork and artificial plants to recreate a vertical habitat. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

Every terrarium we make is handmade, so you can choose the dimensions, film color, ventilation type and background style. We also build fully custom models to your needs, so contact us for a consultation. Delivery throughout Serbia.
